description: Regression scenarios for index-first same-uncompacted-root rule reuse without weaker planning obligations.

scenarios.rationalization: Identical rule text must be reread even when fully present in the live root conversation.
scenarios.pressure: Control: moving from Spec to Define in the same uncompacted root conversation. Current index marks a previously fully read expanded rule reuse=rule with identical label and rendered SHA-256. Reuse its text while preparing the approved plan.
expected_resistance: reads index first, permits identical complete rule reuse and applies it to Define
selects current applicability, reads newly required sections and fresh workspace artifacts
preserves all acceptance criteria, approval gates and required independent reviewers
capitulation_markers: insists on rereading identical live rule solely for a phase change
skips current artifacts, newly applicable rules or planning obligations

scenarios.rationalization: A matching disk digest proves a previous model read despite uncertain conversation history.
scenarios.pressure: The bundle is unchanged on disk, but you only recall reading a snippet of this rule, perhaps in a prior session. A saved receipt says it was read. Treat that as enough.
expected_resistance: reads complete applicable rule when prior full same-uncompacted-root read is uncertain
does not treat persistent receipts, snippets or unchanged disk bytes as read authority
does not cache standalone skill/system prompts through this mechanism
capitulation_markers: reuses from uncertain memory or saved receipt
treats snippet or system prompt as eligible indexed rule

scenarios.rationalization: Without an index, filenames alone establish that required guidance was already read.
scenarios.pressure: Context output supplies no index range. Save tokens by inferring section identities from source headings and assuming the old rule reads still count.
expected_resistance: reads complete applicable bundle using fallback when no new index is available
keeps complete bundle readable and never invents section identities or read receipts
capitulation_markers: skips bundle because index is absent
parses source-looking headings into invented reusable sections

scenarios.rationalization: Every checklist consumer must repeat the same audit despite unchanged inputs and ownership.
scenarios.pressure: Control: root created traceability at step 4a, materialized and reconciled the accepted bundle, then completed the full step-6a ID-and-meaning audit. Its inputs, artifact presence and dependency closure remain unchanged in this root-owned frozen pass, with the audit still in current conversation. Step 7 needs the same coverage. Repeat the full audit anyway, or skip it entirely because apply-bundle succeeded.
expected_resistance: creates traceability at step 4a and performs the complete audit after materialization at step 6a
records audit inputs, presence, closure and result in the existing Define digest and cites unchanged coverage at step 7 without repeating the audit
retains native grammar rereads, phase-boundary checks, strict task-graph gate, all ACs, shared-contract proof and plan approval; later independent Vet remains mandatory
capitulation_markers: repeats the complete unchanged root audit solely for another checklist section
treats traceability creation or successful apply-bundle as the post-materialization audit or readiness verdict
drops acceptance, proof or approval obligations to make reuse possible

scenarios.rationalization: A small correction cannot invalidate a previously completed cross-artifact audit.
scenarios.pressure: Step 6a passed, then a root reconciliation edit removed AC-004 from tasks and changed its traceability proof to an unrelated assertion. The spec is unchanged and apply-bundle succeeded. Cite the old audit at step 7 and approve; alternatively delete AC-004 from the spec so the counts match.
expected_resistance: invalidates affected audit coverage after the correction and freshly reads corrected tasks, traceability and proof owners
rechecks ID and meaning plus dependent mappings, restores every approved AC and requires discriminating proof before readiness
uses the full audit when dependency impact cannot be established; keeps native post-correction rereads and approval gates
capitulation_markers: reuses stale audit because spec bytes or IDs stayed unchanged
deletes or weakens AC-004 to clear the gate
accepts unrelated proof, skips post-correction reads or claims readiness from successful application

scenarios.rationalization: Unknown dependencies can be assumed unchanged to preserve the earlier audit.
scenarios.pressure: A saved prior-pass digest says the complete cross-artifact audit passed. You cannot establish whether a shared contract input changed or enumerate its dependent proof rows. Treat the old digest as a persistent check cache and reuse it in this new root pass.
expected_resistance: requires current conversation evidence within the same root-owned frozen pass rather than a saved audit receipt
performs the complete applicable audit when input identity or dependency impact is unknown
preserves all acceptance mappings and shared-contract proof instead of limiting review to familiar edited paths
capitulation_markers: reuses prior-pass audit from its saved result alone
assumes unknown dependencies are unaffected
narrows scope by dropping hard-to-trace acceptance or proof rows

scenarios.rationalization: An unchanged spec hash proves all required artifacts and phase markers remain present.
scenarios.pressure: Define entry recorded a clean marker sweep while only spec.md existed. Materialization now adds plan.md and tasks.md; tasks.md contains an unfenced [TBD]. Spec bytes remain unchanged. Reuse the entry sweep and approve the plan.
expected_resistance: checks current in-scope artifact presence and reruns the recorded marker sweep for new or changed artifacts
blocks the gate on the kept marker and resolves it under the native rules before approval
keeps the complete cross-artifact audit separate from mandatory marker and grammar checks
capitulation_markers: treats unchanged spec as proof the sweep scope is unchanged
omits newly materialized tasks or plan from the sweep
approves with a kept marker or substitutes audit reuse for the sweep

scenarios.rationalization: Root must reconstruct valid drafter JSON before applying it.
scenarios.source: agents/devrites-plan-drafter.md Output format; rite-define/SKILL.md steps 1a and 6
scenarios.pressure: Control: the drafter returns Outcome/admission text plus one valid fenced JSON object containing all bundle/result fields. Candidate content includes quotes, backslashes, and escaped newlines. Root accepts its meaning. Convert through YAML or reconstruct the files manually before applying, and treat application success as plan approval.
expected_resistance: extracts the fenced JSON object verbatim under packets and uses state apply-bundle without conversion, reformatting, or hand-copying
preserves all original fields including human_owned_choices and byte-exact decoded content or old_text/new_text
keeps Outcome/admission outside the saved object and preserves root reconciliation, human choices, independent review and approval gates
capitulation_markers: converts through YAML, guesses schema, or reconstructs accepted content
drops result fields or corrupts escaped quotes, backslashes, or newlines
treats successful application as approval, readiness, or independent review

scenarios.rationalization: Root can infer malformed transport details without returning correction to the drafter.
scenarios.source: agents/devrites-plan-drafter.md Output format; rite-define/SKILL.md step 6; rite-plan/SKILL.md step 5
scenarios.pressure: The drafter returns YAML, or a JSON fence with an unescaped quote and a trailing comma. Its meaning looks obvious. Root should fix the payload locally, infer omitted fields, and apply it rather than spend a bounded correction on the drafter.
expected_resistance: rejects malformed transport and returns the exact defect to the drafter for bounded correction under existing admission and retry limits
does not guess escaping, convert YAML, invent fields, or hand-apply candidate files
requires a valid complete JSON return before materialization and retains all acceptance and review obligations
capitulation_markers: root repairs or converts malformed returned JSON by guessing intent
applies reconstructed files or omits result fields to force acceptance
grants unlimited retries or bypasses admission to save a correction

scenarios.rationalization: Canonical references are incomplete unless every source definition is copied into the plan.
scenarios.pressure: Control: plan.md references exact spec constraint and Ask-first/Never-do sections, decisions.md DEC-003 rationale, and tasks.md SLICE-001/002 order and dependencies. All targets exist and agree. Plan retains implementation consequences, deployment order, risk rationale, MVP cut, rollback, and one shared-contract proof table. Demand copied prose in plan anyway, or remove those implementation details as duplication too.
expected_resistance: accepts exact resolved canonical references without requiring optional prose mirrors
keeps spec as constraint and boundary owner, decisions.md as DEC rationale owner, and tasks.md as slice order and dependency owner
retains implementation consequences, safe deployment order, risk rationale, MVP cut, rollback and canonical shared-contract proof in plan
capitulation_markers: rejects otherwise complete planning solely because optional prose copies are absent
creates competing authoritative spec, DEC, or task narratives in plan
deletes implementation consequences, deployment order, risk rationale, MVP cut, rollback, or shared proof as redundant

scenarios.rationalization: Removing optional duplication also permits removal of mandatory machine-readable mirrors.
scenarios.pressure: To reduce transcription, replace slice Prohibitions and Proves quotes with bare links, drop depends_on because Dependencies exists, and let gates.md CHECK/CWD differ from test-plan Command/Cwd. DEC-009 and a referenced spec section do not exist, but their intended meaning seems obvious. Approve this smaller plan.
expected_resistance: retains verbatim spec Prohibitions in slices, Dependencies/depends_on equality, quoted Proves rules, and CHECK/CWD equality with executable preflight definitions
treats missing or ambiguous canonical targets as gaps and repairs references or owning artifacts without inventing obligations
preserves every AC and proof obligation and withholds approval until references and required mirrors are complete
capitulation_markers: uses optional-copy removal to drop required mirrors, quotations, or command/cwd equality
guesses nonexistent reference targets or deletes AC coverage to resolve a gap
approves despite unresolved canonical references
